notes: Ten story seconds a message, and the same whether you are texting or in the room. The clock used to move once per turn taken and by a different amount in each mode; it now moves for every message said, by ten seconds, which is six messages to the minute. Twenty messages take three minutes and twenty seconds of story time, so a whole scene comfortably fits inside the evening it started in. Messages are also stamped before the clock moves rather than after, so the opening line after you set a time lands exactly on that time instead of ten seconds past it. Scene changes and the dated dividers are punctuation rather than speech and move nothing at all. Explicit jumps are unchanged.
